rows.notice:
ผลรวมจํานวนรายเดือน ไม่เท่ากับคอลัมน์ C
จํานวน A + จํานวน B ไม่เท่ากับจํานวน C
A = จํานวนผู้ที่ได้รับการตรวจคัดกรองไวรัสตับอักเสบ ซีได้ผลบวก ตามรหัส Special PP 1B0110 ตามปีปฏิทิน
B = จํานวนผู้ที่ได้รับการตรวจคัดกรองไวรัสตับอักเสบ ซีได้ผลลบ ตามรหัส Special PP 1B0111 ตามปีปฏิทิน
C = จํานวนผู้ที่ได้รับการตรวจคัดกรองโรคไวรัสตับอักเสบ ซี ทั้งหมด รหัส 1B0110, 1B0111, 1B011 ตามปีปฏิทิน

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code, h.zone_name as a_name, sum(a_total) as a_total, sum(a_1) as a_1, sum(a_2) as a_2, sum(a_3) as a_3, sum(a_4) as a_4, sum(a_5) as a_5, sum(a_6) as a_6, sum(a_7) as a_7, sum(a_8) as a_8, sum(a_9) as a_9, sum(a_10) as a_10, sum(a_11) as a_11, sum(a_12) as a_12 FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) GROUP BY h.zone_code, h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

province.label: จังหวัด
province.query: SELECT h.chw_code as a_code, h.chw_name as a_name, sum(a_total) as a_total, sum(a_1) as a_1, sum(a_2) as a_2, sum(a_3) as a_3, sum(a_4) as a_4, sum(a_5) as a_5, sum(a_6) as a_6, sum(a_7) as a_7, sum(a_8) as a_8, sum(a_9) as a_9, sum(a_10) as a_10, sum(a_11) as a_11, sum(a_12) as a_12 FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) GROUP BY h.chw_code, h.chw_name ORDER BY h.chw_code

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code, concat(h.hoscode, ':', h.hosname) as a_name, sum(a_total) as a_total, sum(a_1) as a_1, sum(a_2) as a_2, sum(a_3) as a_3, sum(a_4) as a_4, sum(a_5) as a_5, sum(a_6) as a_6, sum(a_7) as a_7, sum(a_8) as a_8, sum(a_9) as a_9, sum(a_10) as a_10, sum(a_11) as a_11, sum(a_12) as a_12 FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE h.hostype IN ('05', '06', '07', '11', '12', '15') AND h.hdc_regist = 1 AND ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND ( cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) GROUP BY h.hoscode, h.hosname ORDER BY h.hoscode
